use default
use System.Math
use System.Numerics.Complex

every_other(x: List[Complex], start: int) -> List[Complex] =>
    x
        |> index()
        |> filter(e => e.index % 2 == start)
        |> map(e => e.value)
        |> collect_list()

twiddle(k: int, n: int) -> Complex =>
    Complex.from_polar_coordinates(
        1.0D, -2.0D * Math.pi * cast double(k) / cast double(n))

fft(x: List[Complex]) -> List[Complex] is
    let n = x.count

    if n <= 1 then
        return x
    fi

    let even = fft(every_other(x, 0))
    let odd = fft(every_other(x, 1))

    let turned =
        (0..n / 2) |> map(k => twiddle(k, n) * odd[k]) |> collect_list()

    (0..n / 2) |> map(k => even[k] + turned[k])
        |> cat((0..n / 2) |> map(k => even[k] - turned[k]))
        |> collect_list()

tidy(v: double) -> double => if Math.abs(v) < 1.0e-12 then 0.0D else v fi

show(c: Complex) -> string =>
    "({tidy(c.real),8:F4}, {tidy(c.imaginary),8:F4})"

let input =
    [1.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D]
        |> map(r => Complex(r, 0.0D))
        |> collect_list()

write_line("input:  {input |> map(c => c.real) |> join(", ")}")
write_line("")

for (i, value) in fft(input) |> index() do
    write_line("X[{i}] = {show(value)}  magnitude {value.magnitude:F4}")
